messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: knit Rhtml files with tikz
parts:
I like a lot the way knit can be used to annotate graphs using the tikz device. 

I couldn't figure out a way to do that when I use knit on Rhtml files though (I want the generated png files to have the latex annotations but apparently it is possible only for pdf output).

Am I missing something?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knit Rhtml files with tikz
parts:
Tikz is for LaTeX only, but nobody can stop you from converting PDF to
PNG. For example, if you have ImageMagick installed, you probably can
call (I'm not completely sure):

convert foo.pdf foo.png

Then you can customize opts_knit$set(upload.fun) to trick knitr to
convert pdf to png, e.g.

<!--begin.rcode setup
opts_knit$set(upload.fun = function(x) {
# x is the pdf filename
x1 = sub('\\.pdf$', '.png', x)
system(paste('convert', x, x1))
x1
})
end.rcode-->

<!--begin.rcode test, dev='tikz'
plot(1)
end.rcode-->

Above is pseudo code but illustrate the basic idea.

Regards,
Yihui
